content.short: TradingLite provides real-time charts and data to aid trading analysis.
content.description: Founded in 2019, TradingLite is a crypto trading analysis platform designed for both traders and investors. It delivers real-time liquidity maps that help users identify the best trading opportunities and gauge where liquidity sits across markets. The platform also makes critical data from crypto exchanges available through analytical charts, including buy and sell volumes, enabling a clearer view of market activity. A broad set of built-in indicators further simplify price data and support users in spotting trends and making informed decisions.
